subject: Sequenced agreement playbook & MAP: staging dependencies and targeted signature lanes
thread_body:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aurelia.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sequenced agreement playbook & MAP: staging dependencies and targeted signature lanes

Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I attached an updated MAP (Aurelia_MAP_v2.xlsx) that lays out the evaluation milestones, legal gating points, and the staged order form approach we discussed. The key goal is to avoid a hard stop at legal review by breaking the order form into: pilot order (30 days), enterprise ramp, and feature add-ons — each with its own acceptance criteria and billing effective dates.

High-level points:
- Pilot acceptance gated by performance eval (2 weeks, pre-production dataset).
- MSA redlines: commercial terms (exhibits) vs DPA (data handling) — DPA must be signed before production keys issued.
- Order form: we propose a small refundable pilot deposit to reserve Dedicated capacity during the trial.

Next steps I propose this week:
1) Karthik to share a short timeline mapping procurement approvals -> legal review -> signature (see proposed dates below).
2) Emma / procurement to confirm any internal procurement blackout dates or PO requirements.
3) Marissa to prepare a single-page acceptance checklist tied to the MAP that legal can reference in the DPA exhibits.

Attachments: [Attachment: Aurelia_MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Manager, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

---

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aurelia.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aurelia.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced agreement playbook & MAP: staging dependencies and targeted signature lanes

Grace —

Appreciate the updated MAP — that layout is helpful. A couple quick questions from procurement/legal:

- SOC2: can you provide the most recent report or a stub? Our security review needs that before DPA sign-off.
- Order form: our procurement team prefers a single consolidated order but we can accept staged billing if the order form explicitly shows delivery milestones. Can you confirm billing milestones?
- Timeline: procurement needs at least 10 business days for PO processing once the MSA/DPA/order form are in final form.

We expect a decision from the pilot committee by 2026-12-20 if the pilot fingerprint looks good, which means we need MSA/DPA fully agreed and order form signed by 2026-12-10 to hit that date.

I'll loop procurement on specifics — procurement@aurelia.com — and they will also need a vendor W-9 and standard contract contact details.

Best,
Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Clinical Data Integration
Aurelia Therapeutics

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aurelia.com>, procurement@aurelia.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced agreement playbook & MAP: staging dependencies and targeted signature lanes

Emma / Procurement team —

Thanks — quick reply with concrete timeline and attachments.

1) SOC2: attached is a redacted stub (SOC2_report_stub.pdf). If you need the full bridge letter, we can request it from security — allow 2 business days.

2) Billing milestones (proposed for order form):
   - Pilot order (Order Form A): effective on signature, refundable deposit invoiced net 30; pilot period: 30 days from provisioning.
   - Ramp order (Order Form B): executed after pilot acceptance; billing starts on production go-live date.
   - Add-ons (features/throughput): separate amendment with its own effective date.

3) Timeline (working backwards to meet 2026-12-20 pilot decision):
   - 2026-12-03: Redwood to deliver clean Redlined MSA (commercial) + DPA draft (Grace / Marissa)
   - 2026-12-06: Aurelia legal to provide comments back (procurement to confirm PO terms)
   - 2026-12-08: Final sign-ready MSA/DPA + Order Form A prepared for signature (DocuSign link to follow)
   - 2026-12-10: Target signature date for MSA/DPA/Order Form A (must be signed by this date to hit pilot decision)

Action items and owners:
- Grace: circulate Redlined MSA/DPA by 2026-12-03 (Grace) [ACTION]
- Marissa: create single-page acceptance checklist tied to MAP by 2026-12-02 [ACTION]
- Emma / procurement: confirm PO lead time and vendor onboarding docs by 2026-12-03 [ACTION]

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_report_stub.pdf (PDF, 45KB)], [Attachment: redwood-orderform-20261201.docx (Word, 28KB)]

If procurement confirms PO timing this afternoon, I'll queue the DocuSign envelope and send the HubSpot deal link for tracking.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if there's anything blocking.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147
